name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Navarre OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View (2024-06) along the entire east edge; the truck entrance is a controlled gap in the fence at the NE corner served by a striped, diagonal pre-gate staging lane (lane markings = checkpoint pinch). Modern fenced freight yard, not an open driveway.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure visible at the entrance in z19-z21 satellite or in any of the ~10 Street View frames walked along the entrance. A modern automated/kiosk check-in is consistent with the layout.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present but no guard shack -> kiosk / app / call-box check-in implied.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and a long dedicated staging lane outside the fence leave ample paved width to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run along BOTH long building faces (east and west), two distinct dock banks -> ship/receive can run from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Web-confirmed 89 loading docks (900,000 sq ft DC, chain's largest); doors visible on both long faces -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop rows north of the building and along the east perimeter road; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 in / 1 out at the single NE gate; not individually countable from overhead, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~180 trailers estimated across the captured tight imagery; approximate overhead count.
fieldNotes.trailerParkingCapacity: ~220 trailer positions estimated across north + east drop yards and dock aprons; approximate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / farmland setting on the southeast side of Navarre OH; open fields east and south.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; a rail line runs ~well west of the site but does not serve it.
